user.title: Set up MeatPi device
user.description:
MeatPi devices (WiCAN and future products) are usually discovered automatically. Use manual setup only if automatic discovery failed.

Enter the hostname or IP address of your device.

data_description.mdns: The mDNS hostname (e.g. wican_xxxx.local) or IP address that Home Assistant uses to reach the device.
data_description.host: An optional alternative IP address to try if the hostname cannot be resolved.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure MeatPi device
reconfigure.description: Update the address Home Assistant uses to reach this device.

data_description.host: An optional alternative IP address to try if the hostname cannot be resolved.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Discovered MeatPi device
zeroconf_confirm.description: Do you want to add the MeatPi device **{name}** at `{url}` to Home Assistant?

abort.no_host: The discovered device did not provide a usable network address.
abort.not_wican: The discovered service is not a MeatPi device.
abort.no_url_available: Home Assistant has no HTTP address the device could push to. Set the internal URL under Settings > System > Network, then retry setup.

create_entry.default:
To send events to Home Assistant, you will need to set up a webhook.

Open the device's web interface and go to *Settings → Services → Automation → Webhooks*

Enable *Webhooks* and fill in the following webhook in the URL field:

`{webhook_url}`

Home Assistant also registers this automatically when it can reach the device. See [the documentation]({docs_url}) for further details.

error.device_mismatch: Device ID mismatch. Expected {expected}, got {actual}. The device may have been replaced or the configuration is pointing to a different device. Please delete and reconfigure this integration.

data.history_sync: Catch up history from the device log (store and forward)
data.history_prefer_live: Keep the live statistics of hours the device also recorded

data_description.post_interval: How often the device pushes data to Home Assistant.
data_description.history_sync: When the device reconnects after being away, the hours it recorded on its SD card are imported into each sensor's long-term statistics (hourly resolution). Needs Store and forward on the device (Automate > Home Assistant).
data_description.history_prefer_live: Off: the recorded hours replace what the live pushes left of the same hour, so the drive's last hour is complete. On: an hour Home Assistant already has is never touched.

firmware_update_required.title: Firmware update required for {device}
firmware_update_required.description:
The device "{device}" runs firmware {installed}, below the minimum this integration supports ({minimum}).

Telemetry keeps working, but device support below the minimum is no longer maintained and some features will not work correctly.

Update the firmware from the device page (the Firmware update entity) or the device's web interface. This issue clears automatically once the device reports a supported version.

webhook_registration_failed.title: MeatPi device unreachable
webhook_registration_failed.description:
Home Assistant could not register its webhook with the device "{device}" after several attempts (tried: {endpoints}).

Until this is resolved the device will not push updates. Please check that:

1. The device is powered on and connected to the network.
2. Home Assistant can reach the device at the address above.
3. The device firewall allows connections on port 80.

The issue clears automatically once registration succeeds.

save_gpx.name: Save GPS track (GPX)
save_gpx.description: Writes the GPS fix the device recorded on its SD card (Store and forward) as a GPX track under www/wican, available as /local/wican/<file>.gpx. Hourly statistics cannot hold a position; this is the time series.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The MeatPi device whose track to save.

hours.name: Hours back
hours.description: How many hours back the track reaches, up to 30 days.
